title: CAMP GX700 gravel bike
notes: Current exact GX700 manufacturer page supports the T800 carbon chassis, Shimano GRX 1×12 build, approximately 10.2 kg small-size complete-bike weight excluding pedals and small accessories, fitted 700×45C tires and CNY 9,999 route. It publishes neither a frame-only mass nor the bottom-bracket shell standard.
